title: Three.js from Scratch
subtitle: 3D for the web with Three.js, WebGL and WebGPU
lead: A step-by-step series for frontend developers: from a first lit cube to shaders, WebGPU and compute. Every part comes with diagrams, screenshots and a live demo you can open in your browser.

planned.title: Post-processing
planned.about: Render to a texture first, then run effects over the whole image: bloom and colour grading with TSL.

support.text: This series is free. If it helped you, you can support it with a coffee.
